about: Listen-review scorecard for the AIVerse sound stack. Ranges are practice windows measured on the shipped stack (PR #36 proofs, PR #35 proof) and the soundLogic constants they came from — not aspirations. See README.md.

checks.fix: If post-gesture state is not 'running', the arm-on-gesture wiring in GlbWorld (pointerdown/keydown -> director.arm()) is broken or the context creation moved out of the gesture handler.
checks.label: No audio reaches the device before a user gesture; it does after

steps.text: Dusk falls on the Sunstone Bazaar. The lamps are lit.
Dusk falls on the Sunstone Bazaar. The lamps are lit.

checks.why: Jim's rule (2026-11-07): audio reaches the user's device only with permission asking, and verification must cover the post-consent chain (context running after the gesture, signal at the destination), not just in-graph levels. The scene performs NO gesture while an announcement registers, proves the destination stayed silent, then gives consent the way the tree under test asks for it: the labelled Enable sound control on consent-gated trees (PR #37+), a raw walk-mode gesture on older gesture-arming trees (the fallback is logged).

checks.fix: Check the wind target/fade in soundDirector.tick (district read, stepFade 1.5s) and that the listener feed reaches the director.
checks.label: Bazaar wind bed at its nominal gain
checks.why: The wind is the always-on layer; WIND_GAIN (soundLogic) is 0.055 and PR #36 measured exactly that in the Bazaar. Peak aggregation makes the reading immune to PA ducking dips.

checks.fix: Check paAudible scope logic, the PA bus analyser path, and that the clip buffer finished loading before the announce.
checks.label: PA announcement heard inside its district

steps.text: Dusk falls on the Sunstone Bazaar. The lamps are lit.

checks.why: The central PA is the verse's voice to everyone in scope: banner + playing clip + analyser energy. PR #36 measured paLevel peaks 0.125 / 0.129 on two runs.

checks.fix: Check districtAt() against districts.json and the wind target when district != bazaar.
checks.label: Wind is Bazaar-scoped: silent in the Glass Quarter
checks.why: District scope is the sound layer's basic geography. PR #36 measured wind 0 in the Glass Quarter.

checks.fix: Check paAudible() and bannerVisible() scope matching; a leak here means every district hears every announcement.
checks.label: PA announcement scoped elsewhere is registered but unheard

steps.text: Dusk falls on the Sunstone Bazaar. The lamps are lit.

checks.why: Scope must cut both ways: a Bazaar announcement from the Glass Quarter registers in the director (announcements +1) but produces no banner, no playback, no analyser energy (PR #36, check a2).

checks.fix: Check the teaRect wiring in GlbWorld's sound driver and the music stepFade (1.0s) toward MUSIC_GAIN / 0.
checks.label: Tea House zone music: full inside the room, zero outside
checks.why: Zone music is keyed to the room rect fact (tea rect [-37.5,-84.5,-12.5,-72.5]); MUSIC_GAIN is 0.17 and PR #36 measured exactly 0.17 inside -> 0 outside. The listener is teleported to the room centre (-25, -78.5); zone membership is a position fact, so no door traversal is needed for this check.

checks.fix: Check emitterGain() against EMITTER_FULL_M / EMITTER_AUDIBLE_M and the stall voice's wiring into the music layer in soundDirector.
checks.label: Mage's stall music swells on approach (positional emitter)

skipIf.reason: stall emitter voice absent from this tree (PR #35 not in the stack under test)

checks.why: Jim's positional emitter (PR #35): emitterGain is full (x MUSIC_GAIN 0.17) inside 2.5 m of (-17, 15.4), squared falloff to silence at 16 m — the pure function gives 0.0597 at 8 m. PR #35's proof measured gain 0.0000 / 0.0597 / 0.1700 at 16 / 8 / 2 m. Each stop polls until the gain converges (the headless frame feed lags teleports by seconds), then samples.
